# Capstone

This part asks whether you can take one study from raw export to
deposit without a chapter telling you which tool comes next. It
closes the second quarter and assumes every part before it, with
Part VI optional. It is about twenty minutes of reading and ten
weeks of work.

- @sec-synthesis takes the HF-HOME study from a multi-site
  case-report-form export to a deposited compendium with a tagged
  analysis plan, executed tests, continuous integration, a one-page
  memo, and a response to a reviewer. It is graded on the numbered
  habits of @sec-habits rather than on the estimate.

The skip advice of the earlier parts does not apply here. The
chapter opens with a 'Ready to start?' quiz instead of a 'Skip
ahead?' quiz: if it is easy, begin the first milestone; if it is
not, the quiz answers name the chapters to revisit first. The
project is the assessment, and it cannot be skipped.
